name: The Testament of Rexxar
summary: Rexxar sends you to the Western Plaguelands with a message for Myranda the Hag. He needs her skill with illusions to pass the Black Flight's defenses.

sections.title: The Art of Illusion
sections.body: Rexxar needs an illusion to pass the Black Flight's defenses. So he sends you to Myranda the Hag, a master illusionist who lives in the Western Plaguelands. The Lordaeron alliance drove her out. She has helped Rexxar's kind before, when a cause seemed worthy. Now you carry his message to her.

sections.title: A Visitor in Lordaeron
sections.body: A member of the Horde is a rare sight in these parts of Lordaeron, Myranda says. Then she asks what you have brought her.

sections.title: Myranda's Answer
sections.body:
Myranda holds the note, pauses, then smiles. She asks after Rexxar and explains that the page was blank on purpose. It held its writer's thoughts and intentions. She sees why Rexxar kept them from ink. The message would have been dangerous if you were captured or killed.

Myranda agrees to help. She owes the Warchief a favor or two.

faq.answer: Myranda the Hag is a master illusionist from Lordaeron, driven out by its alliance. She lives at Sorrow Hill in the Western Plaguelands.

faq.q: Why must you seek out an illusionist?
faq.answer: Rexxar needs an illusion to pass the Black Flight's defenses. He knows a master illusionist who may help.
Rexxar sends you to the Western Plaguelands to find Myranda the Hag at Sorrow Hill.

faq.q: Has Myranda helped the Horde before?
faq.answer: Rexxar says Myranda has helped his kind before, whenever she found a cause worthy.
